description: Check that an invoice is the file ANAF stored, under ANAF's seal (semnatura_*.xml). Give ONE of: message_id (downloads the archive: ANAF allows 10 downloads a day per message), archive (a .zip already in the downloads outbox, from download_invoice; costs nothing), or the two files from an archive kept elsewhere (costs nothing): xml and signature, each { path } or { content_base64, sha256 }, read byte for byte, since the seal covers the invoice's exact bytes. Checked locally first: the certificate against Trans Sped's seal CA and the Ministry of Finance, the signature, and the digest of the invoice's raw bytes. Only when that cannot decide is ANAF asked. Answers valid, checkedBy (local or anaf), a reason when not valid, and the certificate. Revocation is not checked locally.

archive.description: A .zip in the downloads outbox: its name, or its path under the outbox.

message_id.description: The id field from list_invoices (digits), not requestId.

signature.description: The semnatura_*.xml from the same archive: { path } or { content_base64, sha256 }. Never type or paste a file's base64 yourself: a retyped file can arrive changed. Give the path of a file in your workspace folders (the roots this client shares; without them /tmp/churn-hea_52fe), or have a script that read the file send content_base64 with its sha256.

content_base64.description: The file's bytes as standard base64, as a script that read the file wrote them. Needs sha256.

path.description: a file in your workspace folders (the roots this client shares with the server; without them /tmp/churn-hea_52fe); a bare name is taken from the first; or a file this server saved in its outbox, by the path it answered. Read byte for byte.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the source file, as sha256sum prints it: required with content_base64, checked with path. A mismatch fails as checksum_mismatch and nothing is sent.

test.description: For message_id only: fetch it from ANAF's test environment.

xml.description: The invoice XML from the archive: { path } or { content_base64, sha256 }. Never type or paste a file's base64 yourself: a retyped file can arrive changed. Give the path of a file in your workspace folders (the roots this client shares; without them /tmp/churn-hea_52fe), or have a script that read the file send content_base64 with its sha256.

content_base64.description: The file's bytes as standard base64, as a script that read the file wrote them. Needs sha256.

path.description: a file in your workspace folders (the roots this client shares with the server; without them /tmp/churn-hea_52fe); a bare name is taken from the first; or a file this server saved in its outbox, by the path it answered. Read byte for byte.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the source file, as sha256sum prints it: required with content_base64, checked with path. A mismatch fails as checksum_mismatch and nothing is sent.
